The '''''Devoted Technician''''' was one of many such monuments that was erected in the reclaimed [[Monument Plaza/Legends|Monument Plaza]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], constructed by the [[Reconstruction Authority]] in the wake of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. Depicting a [[Technician/Legends|technician]], it was intended as a tribute to the billions of beings and [[Droid/Legends|droids]] who had worked under the Authority's mandate to rebuild [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] after the destruction wrought by that conflict.
